lines.text: NYK notes: Now 13 straight · Towns has recorded a double-double in nine straight games to start the season, which is tied for the second-longest double-double streak to start a season in franchise history. → The notes are behind: the box scores have it at 13 straight double-doubles through 11/15 (every game he has played this season), so where this line ranks it is out of date. 14 if he does it again tonight.

NYK notes: 7th since 1968-69 · Jordan Clarkson has now scored 8,699 points off the bench in his career, passing Thurl Bailey (8,695 bench points) for seventh all-time since the 1968-69 season (when tracking started).
Karl-Anthony Towns: double-double in 13 straight games, every game this season
Series streak · 14: The Knicks have won 14 straight against the Raptors (last: 112-108 on 11/15).
Last 20 · 16-4: The Knicks are 16-4 in the last 20 meetings with the Raptors (since 1/2/22).
Josh Hart started but wasn't on the floor to finish NYK's last 4 close games; he had finished 4 of 4 before, and didn't play in the 4th at all 11/15 vs TOR (close: within 5 in the last five minutes)
Karl-Anthony Towns: 10+ rebounds in 13 straight games, every game this season
TOR has lost its last 3 games after leading by 10+ (22 vs BOS 11/11, 17 vs PHI 11/12, 13 vs NYK 11/15); a fourth straight tonight would be the longest such run in the NBA this season
POR notes: 37th all-time · Holiday is the second current Trail Blazer to crack the NBA’s all-time scoring top 100—Damian Lillard currently ranks 37th on the list (22,845 points).
POR notes — Deni Avdija: 1 of 7 this season · One of seven players in NBA currently averaging 23+ ppg, 6+ apg and 6+ rpg (min. 5 GP).
Ayo Dosunmu since Anthony Edwards last played (10/26), 10 games: 20.1 PPG, 4.9 RPG, 3.1 APG, 1.6 SPG, 52% FG, 43% 3PT (12.0 PPG before); MIN's leading scorer, 7-3 in that span

Rudy Gobert is 27-for-65 from the field over his last 10 games (41.5%, since 10/26); he had shot 67.2% for his career before that (since 2016-17); also 27-for-62 at the line over his last 12 (64.0% before)
Rudy Gobert has 4 games with 15+ rebounds this season: more than 26 of the other 29 teams have in total (13 teams have none)
Ayo Dosunmu as a starter (10 GP, 7-3): 20.1 PPG, 4.9 RPG, 3.1 APG, 2.1 3PM, 52/43/96%; off the bench (4 GP): 12.0 PPG
Damian Lillard has 4 quarters of 25+ points since 1996-97, tied with Kobe Bryant and Joel Embiid for 3rd; the next one puts him alone in 3rd. From the Suns' notes, counted forward here from 11/14
Ayo Dosunmu: shooting 50-40-90 (51.6 / 43.1 / 90.9); one miss from the line takes him off it
Duncan Robinson OUT (left quadriceps strain): DET hasn't played without him this season (8-4 with him)

DET notes: T-2nd in NBA · An active defender, Thompson ranked second in the NBA with 4.3 deflections per game and currently ranks tied for 1st in loose balls recovered per game (see table to the right).

DET notes: T-4th in NBA · Cade Cunningham made all 14 of his free throws, the most he has made without a miss in his career Duncan Robinson knocked down two three-point field goals and his 47 treys are tied for the fourth most in the league this season.
SAS has won 12 straight: a win tonight would be its first 13-game winning streak since 2015-16 (Jan. 2016)
SAS is 12-2: its best start through 14 games since 2013-14 (13-1)
SAS has the NBA's best record since 2004-05 (1100-681)
SAS are the only team that hasn't allowed 120 this season (the other 29 have 143 such games between them)
Stephon Castle on national TV: 22.0 points a game in 4 national games vs 13.2 in his other 10; TS% 56 vs 51 (better in the spotlight) · DET @ SAS on NBC

UTA notes: NBA history · Peterson is also just the 12th teenager in NBA history to record five straight 20-point games, joining an elite group that includes LeBron James, Carmelo Anthony, Luka Dončić, Kyrie Irving, Anthony Edwards and Zion Williamson.…
LAC notes — Darius Garland: Across first 30 games with LAC (3/2 - 11/13), knocked down 90 3PM, second most by any Clipper in first 30 games (trails P. George, 104).
UTA is 1-13: its worst start through 14 games since 2013-14 (1-13)
Mo Bamba has made 6 3-pointers in a row (since 11/15): this season's longest is 7 (Julian Champagnie); the NBA record is 13 (Brent Price, Terry Mills and Shake Milton)
UTA are the only team that hasn't held an opponent under 110 this season (the other 29 have 146 such games between them)
LAC has the NBA's 3rd-best record since 2012-13 (692-448); GSW is first at 710-425
UTA is 1-6 in games within 3 in the final two minutes, outscored 54-29 in those two-minute stretches
Darryn Peterson since Lauri Markkanen last played (11/6), 5 games: 23.6 PPG, 5.2 RPG, 3.8 APG, 44% FG, 37% 3PT (13.6 PPG before); UTA's leading scorer, 0-5 in that span
Luka Doncic: 30+ points in 10 straight games
Walker Kessler OUT (right lower leg): LAL hasn't played without him this season (12-2 with him)

CHA notes: Leads NBA · Diabate currently leads the league in all major offensive rebounding statistics; total offensive rebounds (60), offensive rebounds per game (5.5) and offensive rebounding percentage (19.9%).
CHA notes: 7th in team history · Brandon Miller is 17 3-pointers made away from passing PJ Washington for seventh-most in franchise history.
Austin Reaves OUT (left heel contusion / bone bruise): LAL 2-0 without him (+9.0 a game), 10-2 with; C. Sexton 9.5 → 17.0 pts, J. LaRavia 23.8 → 32.0 min without him (2 games)
CHA has the NBA's worst record since 2004-05 (699-1075)
CHA score the fewest in 4th quarters (21.1 points a game), 4.6 fewer than the next team (MIL): a wider gap than the one across the next nine teams (1.0)
Quentin Grimes on national TV: 4.3 points a game in 4 national games vs 11.6 in his other 8; TS% 45 vs 64 (worse in the spotlight) · CHA @ LAL on NBC
